evals.prompt: Turn this copied reading highlight into a permanent note, but do not let me lazily store the original wording: "Most people mistake repeated exposure for mastery because familiarity is easier to feel than recall is to test."
evals.expected_output: The response should avoid treating the copied sentence as the full final note body, ask for or infer a paraphrased core idea, and produce an atomic card-note structure with source handling.

evals.prompt: I have a rough Obsidian idea: when teams use dashboards as a comfort blanket, they stop asking whether the metric still drives a decision. Please turn it into a card note and suggest two meaningful related-note directions.
evals.expected_output: The response should output one clear card note in complete sentences, preserve atomicity, and include a small related-notes section with reasons for the links.

evals.prompt: These bullets probably belong to more than one note: tutorials reduce fear, checklists reduce memory load, and examples reduce ambiguity. Split them into the strongest card and proposed follow-up cards.
evals.expected_output: The response should identify that the input is not atomic, choose a primary card, and propose split candidates instead of forcing everything into one note.
